text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown was injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ngh......
This is... way more than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true.
Still, there's no need to be pessimistic."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There are views you can only see when facing adversity...
Besides, right now... I feel incredibly sharp.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Right now, I might be able to grasp something new. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Please, let me continue training!
choice_data_list: You should get some rest for now.
If you promise not to push yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Please, let me continue training!
choice_data_list: You should get some rest for now.
If you promise not to push yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "It's okay. You know what I'm capable of when cornered, don't you?"
choice_data_list: Now's not the time to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Now that I've calmed down,
this isn't the time to unleash it..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I think the adrenaline was numbing the pain from my injury...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I ended up causing you trouble, didn't I?
I'll quietly rest for now...

I was relieved she agreed to rest,
but she seemed terribly downhearted.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I know my own limits.
Now, let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry.
Looks like... this is my limit............”

Carrying Satono Crown, who couldn't move due to her aggravated injury,
I rushed back to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's an exercise that won't put strain
on the injured area.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything I can right now... with all my might!
Times like this are when you have to think fast on your feet!

Perhaps the efficient exercise served as rehabilitation...
Because soon after, she was able to resume training ahead of schedule!
